description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Axis_Logarithmic', which handles the rendering and calculation of a logarithmic axis (either X or Y) in a graphing library. It extends a base axis class and overrides methods for logarithmic value transformation, label calculation, and axis intersection.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Axis_Logarithmic
classes.description: Class for handling logarithmic axes in a graphing library, supporting both X and Y directions and providing methods to calculate label positions, axis intersections, and transformation of values into logarithmic scale.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Axis_Logarithmic
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the logarithmic axis, setting default minimum value and label display options.

methods.name: _calcLabelInterval
methods.description: Calculates the label interval for the axis, taking into account logarithmic scaling.

methods.name: _value
methods.description: Transforms a given value into its logarithmic equivalent for axis calculations.

methods.name: _getNextLabel
methods.description: Computes the next label position on the logarithmic axis based on current label and level.

methods.name: _intersectPoint
methods.description: Calculates the pixel position where the axis intersects a given value, handling logarithmic scaling.
